newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSALIISING ASSETS IN MAY 1.9 BLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: HANSALIISING ASSETS IN MAY 1.9 BLN KROONS.

text.p: Hansaliising group's assets rose by 9.8 percent in May to reach 1.9 billion kroons, the company said on Wednesday.
Hansaliising's net income for the first five months was 34.1 million kroons, showing a growth of 8.5 million kroons or 24.9 percent during May.
Total assets of the group rose 48.1 percent from the beginning of the year, the company said in a statement.
At the end of May, Hansa Liising's total assets ammounted to 1.8 billion kroons, Latvian Hanza Lizings to 309.1 million kroons and Lithuanian Hanza Lizingas to 146.4 million kroons.

Hansa Liising's net income for 1997 reached 27.7 million kroons, Latvia subsidairy SIA Hanza Lizing was 4.8 million kroons and Lithuainian subsidairy UBA Hanza Lizingas' net income was 1.1 million kroons.
Hansaliising's share of the Estonian market was by total assets 47 percent and its leasing portfolio was 39.7 percent.
